success_path: Execute deterministic operations immediately; do not add confirmatory reads.
Use one semantic browser batch per page: locate once, fill all fields, perform the declared action, wait once, and reuse the terminal observation.
Consume the previous Action observation instead of rereading DOM, URL, title, route, messages, or values.
Return immediately when the Action stop_condition is met.
failure_only_triggers: SAP returns Error or an actionable/contradictory Warning
A required element is missing or ambiguous
The declared next state is not reached
Save, Submit, Send, Post, Approve, Release, Order, or Delete has no terminal result
The observed state materially conflicts with the compiled plan
hard_validations: Exact STP scope and SAP Fiori surface
Required business inputs and current-run provenance
Match a verified non-production environment, client, object and authorized operation class immediately before each commit.
Unique exact business-object identity where selection is required
Terminal result of Save, Submit, Send, Post, Approve, Release, Order, or Delete
SAP Error, Expected-versus-Actual assertions, critical Evidence, and ambiguous mutation outcome

rules: state_before and state_after are Workflow logical states derived from existing observations; never reread the page only to populate them.

messages and evidence_refs may be empty. Each message is an object with source, severity, and text. Preserve only messages already surfaced by the Action; use source SAP and severity ERROR only for an actual SAP Error, and preserve its text exactly.
The report writes only messages with source SAP and severity ERROR to the SAP error column. Success messages, generated identifiers, and workflow/environment blockers never enter that column.
Use an output identifier shown by the commit response or terminal state. Query object state and idempotency only when the mutation result is ambiguous.
Do not convert report generation success into SAP execution success.
Once stop_condition is met, return without a confirmation read, extra screenshot, or Agent call.

actions.name: Build Test Contract
actions.purpose: Read a structured source once, select authoritative STP rows, and emit a provenance-preserving contract plus conflicts.
preconditions: A snapshot is used only when explicitly verified for the named source.
execution: Reuse the batch execution_contract when supplied. Otherwise run python -X utf8 scripts/build_test_contract.py SOURCE --case-id ID --output RAW, passing the explicit scope selection if present. Run python -X utf8 scripts/compile_execution_input.py RAW [--bindings CURRENT_RUN_JSON] --output COMPILED. Retain RAW unchanged. Use COMPILED.effective_status for case routing and its execution_contract.steps for Action inputs; a READY case can contain a Step awaiting bindings or an external decision.
failure_conditions: Source locked without a verified snapshot
failure_only_validation: Handle a locked source or parser/schema error after the direct parser attempt.
actions.stop_condition: Parser or validated batch Contract emits raw and effective status, source hash, selected rows, issues, and any separate identity resolution; return that result immediately.

actions.name: Inspect Fiori Session
actions.purpose: Bind the existing authenticated Fiori tab and classify its environment with one browser observation.
preconditions: Use an authenticated SAP Fiori browser session for the operator's selected target.
execution: Read the authenticated Fiori marker and the session host/client. Compare them with the requested target and the deployment's explicit environment classification.
Return BLOCKED if sign-in is required, or NEED_DECISION if the session contradicts the declared environment.
Reuse the verified binding until a reconnect, target change or contradictory observation.
failure_conditions: User statement conflicts with URL or client
Environment remains unconfirmed for a mutation
failure_only_validation: Read title, login UI, banner, or extra DOM only when URL plus the Fiori marker is missing or contradictory.
actions.stop_condition: The authenticated Fiori surface, environment and client are verified, or a blocker or conflict is observed.

actions.name: Open Fiori App
actions.purpose: Reuse an already observed matching app or open one pre-resolved Fiori target and wait for one actionable ready element.
preconditions: The compiled profile resolves to one Fiori target.
execution: If session_snapshot already proves the app ready, return without a browser read.
Otherwise navigate to the compiled target and wait once for its declared actionable ready element.
failure_conditions: Ready element not reached within the bounded wait
failure_only_validation: Read URL, title, route, or full DOM only after ready-element timeout or clear wrong-page state.
actions.stop_condition: The declared actionable ready element is observed, or the first target/timeout conflict is observed.

actions.name: Verify Exact Existing Record
actions.purpose: Search one exact key, open its registered read-only route, and evaluate declared assertions in one uninterrupted semantic browser batch.
preconditions: The plan contains one scoped search field/control, one registered read-only target, detail identity fields, and explicit comparators.
execution: In one browser batch, fill the exact key, search, wait once, and extract candidate identities.
For one exact candidate, use the registered read-only locator, wait for one detail anchor, then read all declared identity/assertion fields once.
Apply deterministic comparators and save only terminal Evidence; return zero candidates as FAILURE and multiple/conflicting candidates as NEED_DECISION.
failure_only_validation: Inspect route, title, expanded DOM, or alternate locators only after a missing element, timeout, unsafe destination, or identity conflict.
actions.stop_condition: All assertions are evaluated with required Evidence, or the first zero/many/error/timeout/identity conflict is observed.

actions.name: Execute Authorized Fiori Step
actions.purpose: Execute one compiled Fiori operation plan and evaluate its Expected Result from the same terminal observation.
preconditions: All business choices are already resolved in the compiled plan.
The exact effect class and target object are authorized.
At most one business commit is present.
execution: Compare the cached authorization token locally immediately before a commit; do not call the Agent or reread the browser for this gate.
For each page, locate once and fill all declared fields continuously without per-field confirmation.
Perform the declared action, wait once for its terminal state/message/output, and evaluate Expected-versus-Actual from that same observation.
Do not retry an ambiguous mutation; return the first unexpected state.
failure_only_validation: Read expanded DOM/URL/title only after missing element, wrong transition, or timeout.
Query object state and idempotency only after an ambiguous commit result.
Escalate only actionable/contradictory warnings or unknown business choices.
actions.stop_condition: The declared terminal state/message/output and assertions are obtained, or the first Error, timeout, missing element, wrong state, or ambiguous commit outcome is observed.

actions.name: Render Test Report
actions.purpose: Initialize or update the one Excel report owned by the current Codex conversation without recomputing or upgrading any SAP verdict.
preconditions: The batch owns one .xlsx path under results/ and has an environment/client binding.
For an update, use the saved progress or terminal run manifest for the selected case.
Use existing evidence to report known outcomes and blockers.
execution: Initialize the report with python scripts/render_test_report.py initialize MANIFEST. For updates use python scripts/render_test_report.py update MANIFEST --case-id ID --run-manifest RUN. Use the same report path during recovery.
failure_conditions: Requested Environment/Client differs from the conversation binding
Evidence required by a completed assertion/state is missing
Target workbook belongs to another conversation
Write or required structure check fails
failure_only_validation: Reopen, repair, or visually render a report only after the lightweight check fails.
actions.stop_condition: The current conversation's sole Excel is initialized or updated under results and passes the required structure check, or the first rendering/structure error is returned.
